goal: Set how many days before a subscription payment method expires health reads flag it as method_expiring (method expiry warning window, card expiration threshold, expiring card alert).
whyThisDefault: Thirty days preserves the historical method expiry warning window in subscription_method_health_read while giving subscribers one monthly billing cycle to update an expiring payment method.

effect.appliesTo: Subsequent calls to subscription_method_health_read evaluate active payment method expires_at <= now() + make_interval(days => payment_method_expiry_warning_days_read()) and classify matching expiring methods as method_expiring. When no row exists in public.commerce_settings, the SQL reader defaults to 30 days; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 payment_method_expiry_warning_days_policy_invalid.
frozenOn: Already recorded renewal attempts, retry obligations, dunning notifications, and billing cycles retain their recorded state.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installPaymentMethodExpiryWarningDaysPolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and warningDays. Revision must be a nonblank string and warningDays an integer from 1 through 365.

goal: Set the delay in minutes and recovery link lifetime in hours for recoverable one-time payment decline notices (decline notice timing, recovery link lifetime, failed payment delay).
whyThisDefault: Three minutes of delay avoids sending premature failure notices during rapid retries or synchronous recovery, and 24 hours preserves the established checkout recovery token lifetime.

effect.appliesTo: Subsequent first recoverable-decline transitions on non-subscription orders in payment_provider_result_apply read key='payment_decline_notice_timing' from public.commerce_settings via payment_decline_notice_timing_read(), setting commerce_checkout_recovery_tokens.expires_at (and payload.expiresAt) to now() + make_interval(hours => linkLifetimeHours) and outbox_events.available_at for commerce.payment.failed to now() + make_interval(mins => delayMinutes). When no row exists in public.commerce_settings, the SQL reader defaults to delayMinutes 3 and linkLifetimeHours 24; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 payment_decline_notice_timing_policy_invalid.
frozenOn: Already issued commerce_checkout_recovery_tokens, already enqueued commerce.payment.failed outbox_events, and idempotent payment_provider_receipts replays keep their recorded expiry and availability timestamps.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installPaymentDeclineNoticeTimingPolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision, delayMinutes, and linkLifetimeHours. Revision must be a nonblank string, delayMinutes an integer from 0 through 1440, and linkLifetimeHours an integer from 1 through 168.
